title: Home
description: Factory Line Operations. Open the board that matches your role. Line and plant views show worker_id only; names are on Workforce.

options.query:
| rest /services/authentication/current-context splunk_server=local
| fields username, roles
| eval landing=case(
    match(roles,"flo_workforce"), "Workforce",
    match(roles,"flo_business"), "Enterprise operations",
    match(roles,"flo_plant_ops"), "Plant operations",
    match(roles,"flo_line_supervisor"), "Line floor",
    match(roles,"flo_admin"), "Enterprise operations",
    1=1, "Enterprise operations")
| table username, roles, landing

| inputlookup flo_current_shift_snapshot
| stats dc(site) as factories, sum(eval(state_value="down")) as lines_down, avg(fill_pct) as fill_pct

viz_snap.title: Current shift snapshot (all sites you can search)
